contract.title: Real Estate Sales Contract
contract.preamble: The seller and buyer hereby enter into a sales contract regarding the property indicated below, on the following terms.
contract.depositReceived: is paid at signing and receipt acknowledged.
contract.signatureNote: To certify this contract, the contracting parties confirm there are no objections, and after signing and sealing, the seller and buyer shall affix their seals on each page, and each shall keep one copy.

articles.article1Body: Regarding the sale of the property above, the seller and buyer agree to pay the purchase price as follows.
articles.article2Body: Upon receipt of the final payment, the seller shall deliver all documents necessary for the transfer of ownership to the buyer and cooperate with the registration procedure. The delivery date of the property shall be
articles.article3Body: If there are any mortgages, superficies, leases or other causes restricting the exercise of ownership, or unpaid taxes, public charges or other liabilities, the seller shall remove such defects and burdens by the final payment date and transfer complete ownership to the buyer. However, this does not apply to rights and amounts agreed to be succeeded.
articles.article4Body: The attribution of income and burden of taxes and public charges arising with respect to the property shall be based on the delivery date of the property; provided that, the obligation and responsibility for local tax payment shall follow the provisions of the Local Tax Act.
articles.article5Body: Until the buyer pays the interim payment (or the final payment if there is no interim payment) to the seller, the seller may cancel this contract by refunding twice the deposit, and the buyer may cancel by forfeiting the deposit.
articles.article6Body: If either the seller or buyer fails to perform under this contract, the other party may, after giving written notice, cancel the contract. The parties may claim damages from each other resulting from the cancellation, and unless otherwise agreed, the deposit shall serve as the basis for such damages.
